justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure with a tall headdress, heavily patterned dress and a raised arm, carved in dense low relief that fills the whole field. But the specific forms diverge sharply: A shows a strictly frontal, symmetrical standing figure with masklike face, jewelled apron and small kneeling figures at the base, while B shows a bearded profile figure with large feathered wings striding beside a stylized rosette-bearing plant, and neither the wings, the profile view, nor the floral element has any counterpart in A.
